propositions: scc_loc adapter invokes scc via subprocess and parses JSON to populate AnalyzerResult.loc with per-file line-of-code counts keyed by repo-relative POSIX paths
When scc is unavailable (missing binary, non-zero exit, empty/unparseable output), analyze() returns Unavailable(reason, _ACCRUING_SINCE) with logged warning instead of crashing or fabricating zeros
JSON parser flattens two-level scc structure (data list of language groups, each with Files array) to extract Code and Location fields for each file
Successful empty output (zero files) returns AnalyzerResult with empty files dict and max_loc=0, not Unavailable
Injectable run parameter enables testability without requiring live scc binary
Module stays independent of rebar.grounding layer to avoid metrics-grounding dependency coupling
